en.t: K and I entered the same course of study.

units.source_text: 他若无其事地花着养父家寄给他的钱，走着自己喜欢的路。

en.t: He calmly spent the money sent to him by his adoptive family and went his own chosen way.

units.source_text: K给我的感觉只能说是，养父不会知晓的淡定与被养父知道也无所谓的胆量在K胸中同时存在着。

en.t: The only way I can describe the impression K gave me is that within him there existed both the calm confidence that his adoptive father would never find out and the courage not to care even if he did.
K was even more composed than I was.
During the first summer vacation, K did not go home.

units.source_text: 他说要在驹込的某寺院里借一间房子学习。

en.t: He said he would rent a room in a temple in Komagome and study there.

units.source_text: 我从家乡归来已是九月上旬，看到他果然把自己关在大观音旁的一座肮脏的寺院中。

en.t: When I returned from my hometown in early September, I found that he had indeed shut himself up in a filthy temple beside the Great Kannon.

units.source_text: 他住的是紧挨着正殿的一间狭窄的屋子。

en.t: He was living in a cramped room right next to the main hall.

units.source_text: 看样子，对于可以在那里随心所欲地学习，他很享受。

en.t: He seemed to enjoy being able to study there exactly as he pleased.

units.source_text: 我觉得他的生活越来越像个和尚了。

en.t: I felt that his way of life was becoming more and more like that of a monk.

units.source_text: 那时他手腕上戴了一串念珠，

en.t: At that time he wore a string of prayer beads on his wrist,
and when I asked him what he wore them for,

units.source_text: 他就用拇指一个两个地数着念珠给我看，

en.t: he showed me by counting the beads one by one with his thumb,

units.source_text: 他好像就是这样，每天数无数遍，

en.t: and it seemed that he counted them like this countless times every day,

units.source_text: 可是我不明白这样做有什么意义。

en.t: but I did not understand what meaning there was in doing so.

units.source_text: 念珠是个圆串，一颗一颗地数，到什么时候算个完哪。

en.t: Prayer beads form a circle, so if you count them one by one, when could you ever finish?

units.source_text: 那么，K每次是以怎样的心情，方才停下数念珠的呢？

en.t: Then in what state of mind did K stop counting the beads each time?

units.source_text: 虽属不足挂齿之事，我却常常这样想。

en.t: It was a trivial matter, but I often found myself thinking about it.
